business_model.narrative_summary: Granules operates as a vertically integrated pharmaceutical manufacturing company focused on core APIs, PFIs, and Finished Dosages. Its core strategy relies on high volume, low margin scale economies.

capital_allocation_philosophy.narrative: Prudent allocation focused on core APIs. The company does not chase unrelated diversifications.

execution_track_record.narrative: Consistent track record of delivering margins over the last 10 years, despite pricing pressure in the US.

forward_guidance.narrative: Management has explicitly stated they are expected to grow at 20%+ CAGR for the next three years.

communication_transparency.narrative: High transparency, clear disclosures in quarterly results.

promoter_skin_in_game.narrative: High promoter holding with zero pledge, demonstrating strong conviction.
